description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.GridFilters class, a plugin for Ext JS grids that provides enhanced filtering capabilities through various filter types, UI controls, and state management. It includes configuration options, event handlers, DOM manipulations, and methods for adding, removing, and applying filters.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.GridFilters
classes.description: A plugin class extending Ext.util.Observable that adds filtering functionality to Ext JS grids. It manages filter collection, UI components, store bindings, state persistence, and user interactions for grid filtering.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GridFilters plugin with configuration options, setting up filter collection, default behaviors, and adding initial filters if provided.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Binds the plugin to a grid or paging toolbar, sets up event handlers, and initializes menus and state management.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Restores filter states from persisted data when the grid state is reloaded.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes current filter states for persistence across page loads.

methods.name: onRender
methods.description: Sets up event listener for view refresh and creates filter menus.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event handlers, menus, and filters when the plugin or grid is destroyed.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all filters from the collection and destroys their instances.

methods.name: bindStore
methods.description: Binds a data store to the plugin and sets up appropriate load/refresh event handlers depending on configuration.

methods.name: onReconfigure
methods.description: Rebinds store and resets filters when the grid is reconfigured.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Creates the filter dropdown menu in the grid's header menu, enabling user interaction with filters.

methods.name: getMenuFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the filter object associated with the currently clicked header menu.

methods.name: onMenu
methods.description: Handles displaying the filter menu and synchronizing its state with the filter object.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a filter based on menu checkbox interaction.

methods.name: onBeforeCheck
methods.description: Determines whether a filter can be activated/deactivated based on its compatibility.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Responds to filter state changes, updates UI and triggers deferred store reload based on configuration.

methods.name: onBeforeLoad
methods.description: Augments store load options with filter query parameters for server-side filtering.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Applies local filtering to the store after data load based on active filters.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Updates filter UI indicators when the grid view is refreshed.

methods.name: updateColumnHeadings
methods.description: Adds or removes CSS classes on column headers to indicate active filters.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Triggers filtering on the store, either locally or via server request, based on current filters.

methods.name: getRecordFilter
methods.description: Creates a function that validates records against all active filters for local filtering.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter object to the collection and links it to the plugin's event handlers.

methods.name: addFilters
methods.description: Adds multiple filters from column definitions or configurations, creating filter objects as needed.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter object corresponding to a specific data index.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Deactivates all filters without removing their configurations.

methods.name: getFilterData
methods.description: Returns an array of data objects representing the current active filters.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Constructs URL query parameters or JSON payload from active filters for remote filtering.

methods.name: cleanParams
methods.description: Removes filter-related parameters from a query object, used during re-requests.

methods.name: getFilterClass
methods.description: Maps a filter type string to a specific filter class, aiding dynamic filter creation.
